items: DHL Express - the demand surcharge note now survives any blocker on the same row: a negative NX delta reads "Differenz demand surcharge, ok?", a positive one keeps "demand surcharge ok?". 840257 row 53 is the witness.
DHL Express - an address-correction delta now joins a row that already carries another note, and AC = 11 reads "Address correction, ok?" instead of the misspelled "Addres Correction, ok?".

Dachser - a row with no tariff anywhere in it now reads "Sonderfahrt" when its FR Kosten DL is one of the special-trip add-ons itself (180/150/120/90/110 within 0.02) and no other delta line is on the row. 20261105 row 8 (DE to FR) is the witness: FR Kosten DL 90, whose own FR_DL minus 90 lands on no lane, so the country note "kein Tarif für FR" used to answer instead.

Dachser - "Referenz wird Nx abgerechnet" now also counts a domestic row whose FR Kosten DL is 2 to 5 whole copies of its own FR Kosten lt. Tarif when that copy is not the cell of the row's own bracket (20261105 row 123, 2 x 458.33 = 916.66).
Dachser - the same note now also fits the copies at the Volumen kg DL bracket when the Brutto-bracket readings produce no count (20261105 row 24, 2 x 88.02 = 176.04 against a billed 176.00).

Dachser - the cents-residual "<amount> Kosten für 2.Zustellung etc. ok?" arm now needs an SNK Kosten DL over 500 EUR, the bound the branch above it already read, so a small residual is the Laderaum finding again (20261105 row 140, SNK 76.07 with no tariff base, 76.07 minus 5 = 71.07). Every row that names a 2.Zustellung amount bills over 500 EUR.

Honold - a toll line billed under its tariff adds "Mautdifferenz", a Tauschgebühr delta adds "Differenz Tauschgebühr, ok?", an untariffed toll charge reads "Kein Maut Tarif für '<LAND>'", and freight within 0.50 of its own tariff that matched no older rate reads nothing.

Dachser - a non-domestic row now also reads "Referenz wird Nx abgerechnet" when the reference copies were billed on top of a Sonderfahrt add-on: FR Kosten DL minus one of 180/150/120/90/110 is 2 to 5 whole lane prices of the destination country from the NEW card, that lane is the only one within 0.02 of FR Kosten lt. Tarif, and only one add-on may yield a count. 20261013 row 275 (DE to PL) is the witness, 227.60 - 90 against 2 x 68.81, and it is the only row that changes across the ten audited workbooks.

Dachser - a non-domestic row now reads "Referenz wird Nx abgerechnet" (N = 2 to 5) when the reference was billed more than once on the country lane: FR Kosten lt. Tarif is a lane price at the row Brutto kg bracket on the NEW or the OLD card, FR Kosten DL is whole copies of it, and the phrase stands alone below bundling / ZW / K1AS / K1AU. Witness 20261013 row 29 (DE to RO): 2 x 219.96 against 440.00.

Dachser - a reference billed more than once is now counted on a domestic row from the national zone ladder and on an international one from the country lane prices, so the 1.61.0 note that the count is domestic only no longer holds. Four truth cells stay out of reach, each an external invoice count the row does not carry: 20260904 row 6 (9x), 20261013 row 275 (2x), 20261027 rows 156 (4x) and 157 (6x).

Dachser - an Amazon row with no tariff now reads "kein Tarif für AMAZON DE '37293'" or "kein Tarif für AMAZON PL '05'": an Amazon Empf.-Name, a blank TARIF cell, a non-empty Empf.-Land, Brutto kg at or under 10 t and at least one other delta line, with country plus leading PLZ digits as the token (20261027 rows 146-151). A GB postcode falls through to "kein Tarif für GB", and 20261006 row 205 (Brutto 11573) keeps "Kein Tarif für DE >10 to, ok?".

Dachser - a T1 (Transitabfertigung) line with no tariff base now reads "Transitabfertigung, ok?" after Mautdifferenz: all three T1 columns, a Differenz over 0.08, a Kosten DL over 0.08 and a base at or under 0.08, which makes a blank and a 0 base one case (20261027 row 139, DE to BA). Of 41 released T1 rows, 38 have tariff equal to cost and 2 bill 100 against a 50 base, so this is the only unbacked one.

Dachser - scope of the 2026-10-28 bundle. 20261027 moves from 13 differ to 6 (154 noted, 148 exact, 0 engine-only) and the other nine audited workbooks are unchanged. The six left are not derivable from the sheet: rows 113-115 want the bare "Differenz Automatische Zustellterminvereinbarung" against 208 long-form cells, row 152 appends an annotation no column carries, and rows 156/157 want 4x and 6x counts on Norway lanes the Referenz arm does not cover.

Dachser - a domestic row now reads "Referenz wird Nx abgerechnet" (N = 2 to 5) when the reference was billed more than once: FR Kosten lt. Tarif is the national card cell for the row zone and bracket, and FR Kosten DL is N whole zone prices. The note is terminal and bundling still outranks it; three gates keep it quiet, the tariff copy must sit on the ladder, the smallest decomposition must be unique, and a FR Kosten DL that is itself one zone price is one shipment, not a duplicate (20261019 row 429 reads 5x, row 336 2x).

Dachser - a 110 EUR Sonderfahrt surcharge is now a valid add-on, so 20261019 row 201 (DE to PL) reads "Sonderfahrt" instead of the bisherigen note: 162.70 minus the PL1 lane 52.71 leaves 109.99, inside the 0.5 EUR ratecard tolerance.

Dachser - the builder now writes the national DE card and the two-digit PLZ zone table into the ratecards and the bundle ships both, so the Referenz arm is live once the shared key is entered while a page without the passphrase keeps the previous wording. The supplied workbook loses its decimal separator above 2400 kg, so the builder restores it cell by cell and keeps every bracket through 24000 kg.

Dachser - a K1AV row with SNK_DL 130 now reads "Wartezeit 2h á 65 EUR, ok?" instead of "Standgeld", 130 being 2 x 65 EUR of waiting time (20261019 rows 64/81/99/154). SNK_DL 390 and a non-K1AV 130 keep "Standgeld".

Dachser - a K1AV row with SNK_DL 210 now reads "Differenz Admin Zeitfensterbuchung Handel - Laderaumzuschlag // Speditionskosten gem. Text // Wartezeit 2h á 65 EUR, ok?", 210 being 5 + 75 + 2 x 65 (20261019 row 252).

Dachser - a K1AV 2.Zustellung row whose SNK_DL is the bundle itself now names the billed amount without the flat 5 EUR admin deduction (20261019 rows 22/155), and an integer renders without cents (row 23).

Dachser - a row whose FR, MT and TZ all sit below minus threshold with both volume columns at 0 now reads "zusammengefasste Abrechnung" alone instead of naming that emptiness once per zero line (20261019 rows 327/377/453).

Dachser - a row with an FR delta under 1 EUR inside one weight tier and two weights at least 0.05 kg apart now reads "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte" on domestic and international rows alike (20261019 row 411, 20260903 row 279).

Honold - the engine reads 'FR Kosten lt. Tarif' again: a row whose current-tariff cost is blank or 0 now reads "Kein Tarif für '<LAND>'" alone, and a row whose FR Kosten DL is an OLD-tariff amount from another bracket now reads "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte // Honold berechnet die Kosten nach dem bisherigen Tarif" when the lane also moved on. The previous-tariff arm for the row's own bracket still suppresses the weight half, and both columns resolve through the header row. Replays: 20379045 124/124, 20381523 41/41, 20380293 7/7, 20382640 17/17.

Wackler - a row whose only delta is a 70 EUR SNK gap now reads "Einlagerung 40 €, ok? // Einlagerung 30 €, ok?" instead of "SNK Differenz" (10370017 row 18). The duplicate-billing note now names the row's own ReferenzNr instead of the xxx placeholder, so 10370017 row 126 and 10367543 row 218 differ only on the invoice half, which sits in another workbook.

Wackler - a bundling finding now stands alone, the fuel note is itemised only when the two sides carry different rates (10369563 row 8, 10370014 row 259), a 250 EUR freight delta reads "Zusatzkosten 250 €, ok?" instead of "Pauschalfracht, ok?" (10370014 rows 22/250/253), "SNK Differenz" no longer repeats a weight finding, and a row that starts and ends at the Riedlingen hub is no longer a return. 9 of the bundle's 14 rows now match; the other 5 are not derivable from the row.

Wackler - a row delivered to the Riedlingen return hub (Empf.-PLZ 88499) now reads "Return, ok?" alone, since the freight, maut and fuel gaps on a returned shipment are artefacts of the return (all 11 inbound rows of the 2026-10-21 bundle). A row whose only cost delta is the freight reads "Pauschalfracht, ok?", a fuel delta that is the only finding reads "Differenz treibstoff" and keeps "Differenz Energiezuschlag" when it rides on another finding, and a liftgate credit keeps "Dieselzuschlag ok?".

Honold - the note is decided from FR Kosten DL, never from Volumen kg DL: "Honold berechnet die Kosten nach dem bisherigen Tarif" when the billed freight equals an OLD rate for the bracket its Volumen kg falls in, "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte" otherwise. Volumen kg DL is unreliable when ReferenzNr lists several references, which is why the engine disagreed; 20379045 (124/124), 20381523 (41/41) and 20380293 (7/7) now match in full. Honold training uids change once.

Honold - a row whose ZZ cost line carries a Differenz and whose FR Kosten DL is blank or 0 now reads "2. Zustellung" before the tariff comparison (20381523 row 4). A row that carries freight and a ZZ charge keeps the tariff/weight note, sheets without a ZZ group are unchanged, and 20381523 now agrees on 36 of 41 rows.

Wackler - the note uses the rate card again: the decrypted card arrives after load and the re-read hook lost in a refactor is back, so "Wackler rechnet" is derived from the card and not only from the weight tier. Rows can name a different tier than before.

Header - a "Rates" chip next to the version badge reports whether each tariff dataset is loaded, loading, locked or failed, and hover names the reason (wrong passphrase, unavailable artifact, insecure origin, rejected bundle).
Header - the chip reports a dataset as loaded only when the engine can consume it, so a stale engine shows a problem instead of a false all-clear.
Header - clicking the chip lists the four datasets with the state and reason of each, so a red chip names the dataset instead of only the aggregate.

Dachser - a K1AU special trip is now named from the rate cards before the bundling and doppelt90 branches, so 20261013 rows 271/272/276 read "Sonderfahrt" where FR Kosten DL minus 90 lands on a NEW-card lane.

Dachser - a K1AV SNK Kosten DL of 195 now reads the headline alone, "Wartezeit 3h á 65 EUR, ok?"; the bundled form still strips the 5 EUR admin fee first and keeps its suffix (135 = 2h, 200 = 3h, 265 = 4h).

Dachser - new note "Kalk. Kosten Zustellung", emitted first, from the 196 Differenz column (20261013 row 260 is the only non-zero row in the corpus); the column is exported and UID-excluded like ZABF.

Dachser - an import lane (Abg.-Land not DE, Empf.-Land DE) with SNK Kosten DL 5 and a real Differenz now reads "Differenz Laderaumkostenentwicklung" instead of the automatic ZTV note (20261013 row 359); domestic case-5 rows keep the old wording.

Dachser - a cents-bearing SNK Kosten DL now reads "Differenz Laderaumkostenentwicklung" whenever its Differenz clears the threshold, without also requiring a cents-bearing Differenz (20261013 row 6); rows on the 0.08 boundary stay silent.

Dachser - 20261013 now matches 210 of 218 noted rows (was 203). The remaining 8 (19, 29, 31, 174, 275, 346, 350, 351) carry auditor wording no exported column expresses: cross-document Beleg numbers, a duplicate-reference flag with no per-row signal, and two weight/bundling pairs.

Honold - the note is now decided by the weight brackets instead of the FR amount: Volumen kg and Volumen kg DL in the same Bis bracket of the OLD tariff read "Honold berechnet die Kosten nach dem bisherigen Tarif"; a DL weight in another bracket, a blank or 0 FR Kosten DL, or a missing or 0 Volumen kg read "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte" (a blank or 0 DL weight counts as the same bracket). The destination country is no longer consulted, and rows 4, 44 and 117 of 20379045 are ruled workbook errors, so 121 of 124 match.

Dachser - a Wartezeit row now keeps the bundled admin-fee line after the waiting-time phrase: "Wartezeit 2h á 65 EUR, ok? // Differenz Admin Zeitfensterbuchung Handel - Laderaumzuschlag" instead of stopping at the headline (20260923 rows 216/230/308; 20260917 row 97 has the same inputs and is a worksheet error).

Dachser - a cents-bearing SNK residual of exactly 0.08 no longer reads "Differenz Laderaumkostenentwicklung", while 0.10 and above do (20260917 rows 124/125/126, 20260923 row 295, 20261006 row 184); the non-integer exemption was letting the boundary through on a rounding artifact.

Dachser - the Sonderfahrt / "bisherigen Tarif" note now comes from the rate cards instead of the lane-and-EXP proxy: a surcharge on top of the new card ((FR Kosten DL - 180/150/120/90) landing on a new-card cell) reads "Sonderfahrt", and a tariff read off the old card (FR Kosten lt. Tarif landing on it, x1.15 on imports) reads "Dachser berechnet die Kosten nach dem bisherigen Tarif". Reproduces all 50 such rows across the 20260917, 20260923 and 20261006 sheets, 13 of which the sheet words wrongly.

Dachser - the two rate matrices ship only as the encrypted assets/dachser-ratecards.enc.json (AES-256-GCM, shared team passphrase, same unlock control as the Wackler and Honold tariffs); without the passphrase the note keeps its previous wording.

Dachser - Import-Zollabfertigung is now read from the ZABF columns instead of being dropped: an unbacked Zollabfertigung line on the Oslo lane reads "Einfuhrzollabfertigung" as a trailing note (the seven 20261006 rows with a ZABF Differenz of 50). The column is exported and UID-excluded like c38l_diff.

Dachser - SNK Kosten DL 80 with Serv.-Art K1AV now reads "Speditionskosten gem. Text" plus "Admin Zeitfensterbuchung Handel", the two fee lines the 80 EUR bundles, instead of a bare "Differenz Laderaumkostenentwicklung" (23 rows, all K1AV, Sachkonto 612100).
Dachser - SNK Kosten DL 390 now reads "Standgeld", the three-130-EUR-units form of the existing 130 rule.

Dachser - an empty Tarif cell on a domestic lane above 10 t now reads "Kein Tarif für DE >10 to, ok?" instead of falling through to the Fremdnummer placeholder, because the Dachser weight table stops at 10000 kg (Brutto 11573, FR 566.52).

Dachser - a cents-bearing SNK residual now accepts the 0.08 rounding boundary for the Laderaumkostenentwicklung wording (SNK Kosten DL 2.8, Differenz 0.08); the integer case keeps the strict threshold.

Workbook output - the Anmerkung column is now sized to its own content instead of the reference workbook's fixed 75.71: Excel renders only the literal width the file carries, so the fit is measured from the longest line of the column (shared strings, inline strings and numbers) plus Excel's 0.71 padding, floored at the "Anmerkung" header width. A source column wider than its content is now narrowed to the fit.

Workbook output - the Anmerkung column is now widened to 75.71 (bestFit, customWidth) on every sheet, whether the source workbook already carried the column or the tool created it (Honold 20379045 carried it at width 8.71); a column already at least 75.71 wide is left alone.

New forwarder Honold, one note rule on the Soll-Ist-Vergleich workbook: FR Kosten DL is looked up in the destination country column of the OLD tariff, and a Volumen kg inside one of those brackets reads "Honold berechnet die Kosten nach dem bisherigen Tarif", otherwise "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte" (a blank or 0 FR, a missing or 0 Volumen kg, an unknown country and an FR matching no rate all take the weight branch). Gated on Stat_Freigabe 10, and Honold rows are skipped, never blanked, until the encrypted OLD tariff is unlocked. 112 of 124 rows of 20379045 agree, and eleven rows the workbook labels "Differenz" should read "bisherigen Tarif".

Wackler - an SNK gap of 81 now reads "NL-10, ok?" instead of "Pauschalfracht, ok?": the "SNK 81 >= tariff" fallback was firing on a published Nachlauf surcharge, and the new code-book entry pre-empts it (SNK DL 81.14 against lt. Tarif 0.14, tarif 52.19, no FR/MT/TZ).

Wackler - an SNK gap of 250 now reads '"Zusatzkosten 250 €", ok?', straight double quotes included as the auditor wrote them, instead of the generic "SNK Differenz" (a bare 250.00 surcharge on a tariffed row with no FR/MT/TZ delta).

Wackler - row f9fb4fad stays a not-derivable ledger entry: the truth names Fremdnummer 2544818983 "berechnet in" Beleg 10367544, and neither value occurs anywhere in the workbook, whose own ReferenzNr is 2544828688.

DHL - an extended-liability delta now emits "EXTENDED LIABILITY, ok?" and SNK code 5 emits "DIRECT SIGNATURE , ok?" instead of the generic "SNK Differenz". resolveDHL reads the EL column under the same hasErr() guard as the other surcharges.
DHL - an overweight delta now reads "Differenz overweight, ok?" instead of "overweight ok?"; the old catalog key is retired as an emitter but kept so historical bundles still resolve it.

Train & Export - DHL exports inputs.el_diff, so Diff Mode, the CSV/JSONL training set and the Rule Spec carry the cell the new branch gates on. It stays out of the row_uid seed so every historical DHL uid is unchanged, and is appended last so existing training CSVs keep their positions.

DHL - two audit rows stay unmatched by design: one needs the other Beleg in "Fremdnummer 1060336861 bereits berechnet in STRR000824970, ok?" (not a row of the workbook), one needs the duplicate count in "Referenz wird 6x abgerechnet" (cross-row). Both are not-derivable ledger candidates, not rule gaps.
Rule Tester - DHL gains an EL field and "Extended liability + direct signature" / "Overweight difference" presets.

Dachser - the "bereits berechnet" note now names the row's own ReferenzNr instead of the 5034xxx placeholder: ReferenzNr 2544567001 yields "Fremdnummer 2544567001 bereits berechnet in RE00123xxx, ok?". The Beleg stays a placeholder because it is cross-document and never a row of the workbook it appears in.

Anmerkung - phrase identification no longer emits a ?: sentinel for an interpolated Dachser Fremdnummer note: the catalog value carries xxx / RExxx placeholders that no real digits could match, so a new template family resolves both hand-written suffix shapes plus the placeholder form. Diff Mode reports 2 unknown-phrase rows instead of 3.

Train & Export - Dachser ReferenzNr is now exported as an inputs.referenz cell, so the Diff table, the training set and the Rule Spec carry the value the already-billed note interpolates. The exclusion from the row uid is scoped to Dachser, since K+N and Wackler have always hashed their own referenz, and the column is appended last.
Rule Tester - Dachser gains a ReferenzNr field and a "Fremdnummer already billed" preset, and the stale dachser copy of the "Fremdnummer empty tarif" preset is dropped.

New - "Invoke the Ritual" and "Transmute All Scrolls" now ask how the group Differenz columns of the result should be coloured: Normal / Bad / Good / Neutral, in a popup with colour swatches and arrow-key navigation. Normal writes nothing, the other three set the fill and text colour to Excel's own Bad / Good / Neutral cell styles in xl/styles.xml on the workbook's own theme font, keeping text @ and numeric #,##0.00 formats, and a sheet without such a column is passed through. The choice is stored as anmerkung.diffstyle.v1 and pre-selected on the next run.

Dachser - a positive FR delta at equal or same-tier weights on an international lane (RS/CH import or PL export) now emits "Dachser berechnet die Kosten nach dem bisherigen Tarif" instead of "Frachtdifferenz": on non-DE lanes the auditor reads the freight gap as the previous rate-card version (15 bundle rows). Domestic equal-weight rows keep "Frachtdifferenz", and all 158 solved rows of 20260917 replay unchanged.

Dachser - the blank-TARIF note "kein Tarif für <Land>" now also fires on outbound international lanes (Empf.-Land not DE), so DE to RO with a blank TARIF and 1783.7 FR reaches it instead of the Fremdnummer literal.

Dachser - K1AV rows whose SNK_DL bundles the flat 5 EUR admin fee now strip it and name the residual: a whole multiple of 65 reads "Wartezeit 2h á 65 EUR, ok?", any other cents-bearing residual reads "931,15 Kosten für 2.Zustellung etc. ok?". Integer residuals that are no 65-multiple and the SNK_DL 75 Speditionskosten branch are untouched, and new templates keep both phrases key-mappable in Diff Mode.

Wackler - new SNK code |SNK| ≈ 16 (± 0.5) reads "NIGHTFIX", the fixed-price night-delivery fee in the NL-FIX / NL-12 / NL-SPEZ family: Kosten DL 17.26 against Kosten lt. Tarif 1.26 is a 16.00 gap and the only cost signal on the row, so the auditor names the product instead of the generic "SNK Differenz". All 159 solved rows of 10365132 replay unchanged.
Dachser - weights in the same rate-card tier with a positive FR delta now emit "Frachtdifferenz".
Dachser - removed the legacy sachkonto === 'X' VORHOLUNG trigger, which was masking weight deviations and freight differences on billed rows.
Dachser - the weight branch consistently emits the plural "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte", including for equal weights with an FR below -1.0 and no other trigger.
Dachser - a small positive FR delta below 1.0 EUR on differing weights now classifies as "Frachtdifferenz".
Dachser - added Abg.-Land / Empf.-Land resolution, so blank-tariff rows inbound from a non-DE origin now emit "kein Tarif für <Land>" (e.g. "kein Tarif für PT").
Dachser - Vorholung now requires every other surcharge and difference column (TZ, MT, EXP, SNK, ZZ and so on) to be zero, so VORHOLUNG is emitted only on a row whose only delta is FR.

AI Bundle - each pattern's signature_hypothesis is now replayed against the full same-forwarder regression set at export time, so a hypothesis that also matches solved rows outside the contrast set is machine-disproven before the AI patches. Summary schema bumps to anmerkung.training-summary/v3.
AI Bundle - numeric_profiles now carries min_abs on *_diff keys, the smallest observed delta, so the consumer copies a real gate boundary instead of inventing one.

AI Bundle - a pattern whose failing rows share no value and no numeric shape now carries no_common_signal: true, steering the consumer to split the pattern or mark the rows not-derivable rather than force a gate.

Dachser - fixed a crash introduced by the ZZ "2. Zustellung" change: the FR equal-weights branch still referenced the removed zzVal variable, now re-declared locally and keeping the FR wording variant (ZZ=35 reads "Fracht Differenz", otherwise "Frachtdifferenz").
Dachser - added a 38L header search (fc('38L', 'Differenz')) to emit "Maut von/bis NL" when a difference is present (bundle row 88, 2026-09-01).
Dachser - fixed the adminZeitfensterDiff wording to "Differenz Admin Zeitfensterbuchung Handel - Laderaumzuschlag", the missing hyphen having made 15 rows of the 2026-09-01 bundle read wrong.

Wackler - in the 7+ Colli weight cascade, the pallet volume gate now needs the pallet volume to exceed the declared volume weight by at least 5% (or 10000 kg) before it classifies as a weight discrepancy, so sub-1% boundaries resolve to "Wackler rechnet".

Wackler - the storage-fee finding on un-tariffed, code-less SNK rows is now a query, "Lagergeld, ok?", since it is a charge to confirm rather than a proven discrepancy (bundle 2026-08-31, four Haldensleben rows).

Wackler - the 7+ Colli weight classification no longer compares the synthetic pallet-volume weight against the billed weight, which produced 17 of the bundle's 32 misses: the finding is read off the real weights and the reference count, with different tiers reading "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte", weights 1-5% apart on a multi-reference row reading "hätte gebündelt werden müssen", the same tier with 6+ references bundling, and pallet volume running ahead across tiers a weight discrepancy. An over-billed fuel gap stays itemised.

Wackler - retired the light-row bundling carve-out (1000 kg or less on identical weights), which rested on a single row absent from the 2026-08-31 evidence set; identical weights on one shared tier are one tier rate at any weight.

Tests - the Node harness now falls back to the last git revision that carried the local-only Wackler ratecard files, so rate-dependent tier tests stay faithful in a plain clone; pins for pre-flag Kontierung and flat Fremdnummer wording are updated, and every branch of the 7+ Colli cascade is pinned (203 passing).

Diff Mode - all resolved rule-input columns are now retained in the detail view, Diff CSV, Training CSV/JSONL and AI Bundle even when their cells are blank, which keeps blank gate signals while historical row_uids stay stable and blank worksheet padding is dropped.
What's New - the changelog now opens automatically once per new version; the News button still reopens the full history.

Wackler - for rows with at least 7 Colli, the weight classification compares Volumen kg DL against max(Colli x 285, Volumen kg, Brutto kg): different tariff tiers read "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte", the same tier reads "Wackler rechnet".

Dachser - rule engine updated from the 2026-08-31 labeled bundle: Admin-Zeitfenster wording corrected, material equal-weight freight differences retained, ZZ=35 credits recognized, UK zone and customs checks added, and the 90 EUR duplicate Sonderfahrt signature recognized.

Dachser - the ZW note now reads the dedicated KI_ZW_PLZ / KI_ZW_ORT (Zwischenempfänger) columns instead of Empf.-PLZ/Ort, which on every REFERENZ3=ZW row of the supplied workbook name a genuinely different location (row 69 resolves "90451 Nürnberg" against the shipment's "Chisinau"). It falls back to Empf.-PLZ/Ort on older layouts, and the column is now exported and read.

Dachser - daZWNote's inputs and REFERENZ3, Serv.-Art, Sachkonto, Anz.Sdg, Empf.-PLZ and Empf.-Ort now resolve via header match, with the old fixed positions kept only as a last resort: on the current layout they silently pointed at the wrong cells (index 13/14 landed on Empf.-Name/-Land, Sachkonto moved from 35 to 37). A future column insertion now fails loudly as -1 instead of reading the wrong cell.
Diff Mode - Dachser rows now capture ki_zw_plz / ki_zw_ort in the per-row inputs bag, so the drawer, CSV and training set show the hub address the note read; both keys are UID-excluded.

Rule Tester - Dachser gains KI_ZW_PLZ / KI_ZW_ORT fields wired through the synthetic worksheet builder and the diff-row remap; the old "ZW intermediary" preset is kept as "legacy, no KI_ZW" to pin the fallback, and a new preset exercises the KI_ZW path.

Verification - daZWNote and the full processDachser pipeline ran against the supplied Straße 116 workbook with real headers and no mocked data: all 9 ZW rows resolve ki_zw_plz=11 / ki_zw_ort=12, and a gate-open clone of row 69 emits "Mautdifferenz // Differenz aufgrund abweichender Zwischenempfänger 90451 Nürnberg" from KI_ZW_PLZ/ORT rather than "Chisinau".

Wackler - SNK ≈49 and ≈113 join the code book as onward-carriage queries, "NL-12, ok?" and "NL-SPEZ, ok?", instead of falling through to the generic "SNK Differenz"; AVIS codes stay additive ("Avis, ok? // NL-SPEZ, ok?"). Both phrases are promoted into the catalog so training exports resolve stable keys.

Wackler - a cross-tier multi-reference row whose billed weight is at most a fifth of the chargeable weight (VKG_DL <= 0.2 x VKG) now reads a terminal "hätte gebündelt werden müssen": the bundle was billed as one consignment while the tariff rated the combined load, so the AVIS/MT/TZ/SNK deltas on the row are artefacts and are suppressed. Comparable weights still read "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte".
Verification - all 5 failing bundle rows now match truth, all 113 regression rows replay unchanged, and all 200 rows of the four corrected Soll-Ist workbooks match; 5 new pinned tests (185 passing).

AI Bundle - rule_spec.json gains phrase_emitters: every phrase key mapped to the function whose source emits it, from a token and literal scan of the live source plus the SNK code book. All 77 keys resolve to at least one emitter, pinned by test; an empty list means the fix is a new branch, not a gate change.

Wackler - the change is additive: the direct rate-card lookup runs first and only overrides when a published tier rate matches within tolerance, otherwise the v1.27.0 walk runs unchanged. Sheets without the FR Kosten columns behave exactly as before, and the 176-row replay changes only ec0469d0.
AI Bundle - fr_tarif and fr_dl are now exported in the Wackler inputs, canonical order, glossary and rule tester, so the tariff-tier reading is verifiable in Diff Mode.
Tests - 3 new cases pin the freight-column reads against real values, and both Soll-Ist workbooks match 82/82 rows (121 passing).

Row ec0469d0 (GB2, VKG 2496 into 2600, FR +310.3 exactly) now names 2000 three steps down, while the ghost guard and 52fa91df stay unchanged.

Wackler - GB zone now resolves from Empf.-PLZ alone when there is no Empf.-Land or Tarifzone column: a UK postcode always leads with letters and cannot be mistaken for a five-digit German PLZ, while numeric codes and Irish "D24" still resolve to null.
Tests - 2 new cases pin the 3-step near-exact down-tiering with a Land-less GB postcode and the guard that a bare numeric foreign PLZ never resolves a GB zone (118 passing).

Wackler - billed-tier re-tiering is now bidirectional but still adjacent-only: besides the credit step up, a positive FR delta that exactly matches the published gap down to the floor tier re-tiers one step down (row f6cb2770, NL 2200 to 2000, FR +17.83). Tests - 4 new cases pin the weighed and unweighed SNK=80 branches and the positive-FR floor-tier down-tiering (116 passing).

Wackler - the "Wackler rechnet Frachtrate für <tier>kg ab" note is plain tier wording again: the national-card "(DEn: ... €)" suffix is gone, because the auditor strips any rate-card decoration from this phrase. Wackler - billed-tier re-tiering is now credit-only and adjacent-only. Wackler - cross-tier multi-reference rows gain a bundling branch: weights within 20% of the larger and a positive FR delta read "hätte gebündelt werden müssen" instead of "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte" (5465.44 against 6158 kg, FR +65.6). Wackler - two bundle rows are documented as irreducible: 72cd0079 and 250a1f2a expect "Fremdnummer ... bereits berechnet in <other Beleg>, ok?" notes naming another workbook's document number, which row inputs cannot derive.

Diff Mode - phrase-to-key resolution now shares normPhrase semantics with the diff: previously a double-space or NFD catalog phrase compared equal yet exported as an unmapped ?: sentinel and split one failure pattern in two. Diff Mode - compound catalog phrases resolve per half: elevatedRestricted is two phrases joined with " // ", and cells are split before key lookup, so neither half ever matched the joined entry and DHL rows exported ?: sentinels. The reverse index now indexes each half under the same key.

Diff Mode - granularLabel emptiness is now phrase-level like classifyDiff, so a cell holding only separator garbage no longer sub-labels as overfired_full while the top-level label says correct, and two garbage sides read empty_match. The case and whitespace checks fold through NFC too.

Tests - 12 new cases pin the hardening, including a catalog-wide guard that no two PHRASES entries fold onto each other (known exception: the Kontierung case pair); the harness now exposes the catalog (104 passing).

AI Bundle - new summary.json pre-aggregates the corpus into failure patterns, one per forwarder and engine_missing / extra_phrase_keys combination, sorted by row count, each with a suggested_action, the label distribution, up to 5 example row_uids, shared_inputs (identical on every failing row) and varying_inputs (must not become gate conditions). AI Bundle - new prompt.md: the ready-to-paste prompt the bundle always promised but the README only paraphrased, encoding the authoritative-field rule (engine_* over A-vs-B), the pattern-first workflow, the engine constraints and the expected diagnosis, patch, covered row_uids output, with live pattern counts interpolated.

Training exports - records are sorted deterministically (forwarder, source pair, sheet, row), so training.jsonl and the Training Set CSV are diffable line for line regardless of sheet or bulk pair order.
AI Bundle - README.md gained a "Start with summary.json" step and the new file inventory, the export log reports pattern counts, and the button tooltip lists the new contents.
Tests - buildTrainingSummary coverage for pattern grouping, solved-row exclusion, shared vs varying derivation, the a_vs_b fallback, count-descending order and the fix_both action (92 passing).

Diff Mode - per-phrase highlighting in the Before / After columns: phrases both sides agree on stay neutral, one only A has is struck through red and one only B has is green, so the disagreeing phrase is visible at a glance on multi-phrase rows. Built on the row's existing missing / extra buckets (new phraseCellParts), so the table agrees with the phrase-diff block and the exports.

Diff Mode - the hard 500-row render cap is now a pager: a "show 500 more" button extends the table page by page, and the cap snaps back to one page when the filter changes or a new Train & Compare runs. Exports still honour the full filter scope.

Diff Mode - the four classic summary tiles are clickable filter shortcuts (total to all, added to missed, removed to overfired, changed to wrong), highlighted and kept in sync with the chips including aria-pressed.

Diff Mode - fixed the Forwarder / Sheet dropdowns, which never filtered: the inline onchange re-rendered before the listener mirrored the value into filter state, and the render wrote the stale value back, silently reverting the choice. The search box had the same one-keystroke lag; refreshDiffView now reads the live controls first.
Tests - added phraseCellParts coverage (changed-phrase flagging, case and whitespace matching, empty cells) and exposed it from the harness.

Wackler - added "Dieselzuschlag ok?": on a Hebebühne credit row with a co-occurring TZ or fuel delta, the auditor's query is emitted instead of the generic "Differenz Energiezuschlag". The fuel gate itself is unchanged, only the wording switches when the Hebebühne branch fired (bundle row ce9f73d9).

Wackler - the "Wackler rechnet Frachtrate für <tier>kg ab" note now reports the tier actually billed, not just the chargeable-weight tier: when the FR delta equals a clean gap between neighbouring tiers, wacklerBilledTier computes the billed freight and matches it back to the tier whose rate fits. It degrades to the weight tier without a card, zone or clean step (row e40698ee, TR 7000 into 7500, FR -59.34).

Wackler - billed-tier re-tiering and the booked EUR enrichment now bind a row to its card and zone through one wacklerRateProbe: the national DE card is tried first, then the international one, so domestic German rows re-tier too.

Wackler - domestic vs international is now classified from Abg.-Land / Empf.-Land: DE to DE is domestic with the zone from the numeric Empf.-PLZ, a foreign end is an international lane keyed by country and that side's PLZ. With the country known the bare-PLZ guard is lifted, and foreign rows carrying German-looking postal codes no longer pick up a bogus suffix.

Tests - added Wackler cases for the Dieselzuschlag wording, billed-tier re-tiering (zone token, fallback, Empf.-Land), domestic re-tiering from Empf.-PLZ and the German-looking foreign PLZ guard (85 passing).

Diff Mode / Rule Training - every diff row now carries an engine-vs-truth comparison: how the current engine scores against ground truth, not just how your tool's output compares. Per-row and export fields cover the label, match, Jaccard and the missing / extra phrases and keys, and a fix is complete when engine_matches_b flips to true.

Diff Mode - a row where the tool was right (label=correct) but the current engine disagrees with truth is now kept in the default table and training export instead of hidden; pure positives stay opt-in.
Diff Mode - the row detail gained an "engine vs truth" block with should add / should remove chips, and the Diff CSV, Training Set, AI Bundle README and Rule Spec document and emit the new fields.

Diff Mode - removed the dead legacy helper cluster (FW_RESOLVERS, tsResolverScore, tsDetectForwarder, tsLabelFor, tsCollectInputs, tsRunRule), whose copies had drifted from the live path, collapsing to one code path.
Tests - added tests/diff.test.mjs covering classifyDiff, computePhraseDiff, granularLabel, rowUid and the engine-vs-truth derivation (69 passing).

Wackler - the "Wackler rechnet Frachtrate für <tier>kg ab" note no longer appends the booked rate-card EUR amount, so "... für 3000kg ab (NL: 482,60 €)" renders as "... für 3000kg ab". The auditor wants only the weight bracket, and the phrase still resolves to the tpl_wacklerRechnet template key; joined classifications such as "// Mautdifferenz" are unaffected.

Wackler - the official zone division now ships inside the rate-card asset, generated from the Zoneneinteilung workbook, mapping a destination country plus postal prefix to a rate-card zone for 13 countries, which is what multi-zone countries need.

Wackler - new WACKLER_RATECARD.resolveZoneByPostal(country, postal) resolves a destination sub-zone: numeric countries key on the first two postal digits with leading zeros kept, GB on the longest alphabetic postcode area, and ES carries its AD / GI tokens; unknown countries, blank postals and unmatched prefixes return null.

Wackler - resolveZone takes an optional destination postal code and consults it only when the token alone is ambiguous, so CH with "8001" resolves to CH1 while explicit zone codes and single-zone countries are unaffected.

Wackler - the same-tier "Wackler rechnet" note now resolves the zone from Empf.-Land plus Empf.-PLZ when no explicit token is present, so the booked EUR amount is appended for multi-zone international destinations too; domestic rows and rows without a destination are unchanged.

Wackler - the international freight rate card now ships as its own asset, assets/wackler-ratecard.js, loaded before the engine, so the 45 x 42 matrix lives outside anmerkung.js and can be regenerated from the workbook without touching engine logic.

Wackler - the tier breakpoint table is now sourced from the rate-card asset, so the classifier and the rate lookup share one source of truth, with an identical inline fallback for contexts without the asset.

Wackler - the same-tier "Wackler rechnet" note is enriched with the booked rate-card amount when the row carries a resolvable destination zone, e.g. "... für 150kg ab (FR2: 87,49 €)", so the auditor sees the exact cell billed against. Ambiguous multi-zone countries and blank tokens fall back to the plain tier wording.
Wackler - resolveWackler now locates a destination zone column under Tarifzone, Empf.-Land, Bestimmungsland, Ländercode, Country, Zone or Land; without one the enrichment does not fire.

Wackler - fuel wording changed from "DifferenzTreibstof" to "DifferenzEnergiezuschlag", now a catalog entry (key differenzEnergiezuschlag) and the auditor's dominant wording. The legacy string stays in the literals so older exports still resolve to a stable key.

Wackler - the fuel surcharge is no longer suppressed when a row carries both a freight and a toll delta: the auditor lists the energy surcharge as its own classification beside FR and MT, and it is still absorbed on same-tier "Wackler rechnet" rows.
Wackler - Mautdifferenz is now always additive when the toll delta clears the threshold, including on same-tier "Wackler rechnet" rows where it was suppressed.

Wackler - bundling now takes precedence over the same-tier rate-card wording: both weights in one tier plus a comma-joined ReferenzNr and an FR delta read "hätte gebündelt werden müssen" instead of "Wackler rechnet Frachtrate für <tier>kg ab", while cross-tier multi-reference rows stay a weight discrepancy.

Wackler - combined effect lifts Diff-Mode agreement on the 2026-06-04 bundle from 19/46 to 28/46 with no regressions. The residual mismatches are auditor variance: manual truck-capacity notes, per-workbook fuel wording, hand-picked tiers and a few Pauschalfracht edges.

Wackler - the protected-phrase preservation mechanism is gone: processWackler no longer reads the existing Anmerkung cell and never short-circuits when it already holds a protected phrase, so every in-scope row is recomputed from its inputs and the rules are the single source of truth.

Weight cascade - cross-tier weights with a real weight on both sides and an FR delta remain "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte", while same-tier or identical weights emit the terminal "Wackler rechnet Frachtrate für <tier>kg ab".
Diff Mode - the Engine-Now column no longer shows a false drift dot on rows whose slot-A cell carried a protected phrase, since the engine now recomputes like every other cell.

Preview and stats - the "preserved (protected)" stat and the per-row preserved status are retired, a null processor result now always means out of scope (Stat_Freigabe not 10) and counts as skipped, and the Rule Tester preset became "Cross-tier weights".

Wackler - new "Lagergeld" classification: a blank booked tariff with an SNK charge as the only cost signal and no FR/MT/TZ delta or AVIS code now reads "Lagergeld" instead of the generic "SNK Differenz". It resolved 18 mislabelled and 1 missed row, the largest single cluster in the bundle.

Wackler - new "hätte Hebebühne abrechnen dürfen" classification: a large negative SNK of about -150 that matches no recognised surcharge code is the auditor's liftgate-credit signature, now a catalog phrase with a stable key instead of an unmapped ?: phrase. The window is narrow so it never poaches real SNK Differenz residuals.

Diff Mode - new Bulk sub-panel compares many predicted / expected workbook pairs in one pass: files auto-pair by filename with role words and trailing a/b markers ignored, a live preview shows every match, flags collisions paired by sorted order and lists unmatched files.

Diff Mode - all bulk pairs merge into the same results bundle, so the breakdown chips, filters, per-row table, Send-to-Tester and every export operate on the combined corpus; single-pair runs are unchanged.

Diff Mode - every row now carries provenance: a source_file column in the Diff and Training Set CSV, a source_file field in the JSONL, the source pair in the table and drawer, and free-text search matches it. Single-pair runs leave it blank.

Diff Mode - row_uid namespaces by source pair in bulk mode, so identical forwarder, sheet and inputs in different files stay distinct; single-pair row_uids are unchanged so old training CSVs still join.

Wackler - new SNK code: |SNK| ≈ 25 (±0.5) now reads "Terminzustellung", a flat timed-delivery surcharge, instead of the generic "SNK Differenz", and the phrase is in the catalog so exports resolve a stable key.

Wackler - the weight and bundling cascade is reworked: a cross-tier multi-reference gap no longer reads "hätte gebündelt werden müssen" but "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte", and bundling is reserved for the legacy no-weight-signal multi-ref FR case.

Wackler - the same-tier "Wackler rechnet" note also fires when VKG and VKG_DL are identical, provided both carry a real weight and an FR delta, and it suppresses the MT and TZ deltas as systemic tier rounding.

Wackler - the additive fuel note is suppressed when a row carries both a freight and a toll delta, since the TZ gap is the surcharge on freight plus toll; the pure-TZ fallback and the TZ-only trigger are unchanged.

Diff Mode - engine-drift detection is now phrase-set aware: the drift chip, the amber engine cell and the engine_matches_a column compared with raw string equality, so a row emitting the same phrases in a different order, casing or spacing was wrongly flagged. runDiff now compares through samePhraseSet(splitTriggers(...)), so drift fires only when the rules genuinely changed.

Diff Mode - row labels are now phrase-set aware, removing the biggest source of false wrong rows: A and B holding the same phrases in a different order, casing or spacing no longer count as a rule disagreement. Identical sets read correct, empty A reads missed, empty B reads overfired, and genuinely different content reads wrong.

Diff Mode - phrase comparison normalizes whitespace as well as case (normPhrase = lowercase, collapse inner whitespace, trim), so a stray double space lands in common_phrases instead of splitting into missing and extra, and the Jaccard and chips reflect real signal.
Diff Mode - common, missing and extra phrases are de-duplicated on the normalized form, so a repeated phrase can no longer inflate the bucket counts or push Jaccard above 1.0.

Diff Mode - new granular label "reordered" for identical phrase sets in a different order, rendered as a green match badge and documented in the rule spec taxonomy, whose correct and wrong descriptions now spell out the order, case and whitespace insensitivity.

Diff Mode - every row now carries a phrase-key reverse lookup: predicted, expected, common, missing, extra and engine phrases map to stable identifiers, a catalog key, a lit_* synthetic for hard-coded literals or a tpl_* for dynamic templates, with anything unmapped surfacing as ?:<raw phrase> so promotions are visible at a glance. An AI consumer can grep the keys against the engine to find the responsible branch.

Diff Mode - every row also carries processor (the exact symbol to edit, e.g. processWackler) and applicable_threshold (the hasErr tolerance for that forwarder), both flowing through the Diff CSV and both training exports.

Diff Mode - new export "Rule Spec (JSON)": a self-describing schema with the full catalog, the literals and templates, per-forwarder thresholds, the gate, processor and resolver symbols, canonical input order and an English glossary for every input key, with the engine version stamped from the changelog.

Diff Mode - new export "AI Bundle (ZIP)": one click packages the filter-scoped training set, the rule spec and a README whose prompt template walks an assistant through the rule-update workflow, so the ZIP alone is enough to propose a patch without reading the source.

Diff CSV and Training Set - the column layout now leads with row_uid, sheet, row, forwarder, processor and threshold, then label and phrases, then the phrase-key columns, then reason and canonical inputs, so successive exports of the same workbook still line up column for column.
Diff Mode - the intro copy now surfaces the AI Bundle as the recommended export for AI-driven rule updates; the other flows are unchanged.

Diff Mode - the training set now carries a phrase-level diff per row, not just the coarse label: predicted, expected, common, missing and extra phrases plus a Jaccard score, so a wrong row says exactly which phrase the engine missed and which it over-fired. Comparison is case-insensitive and preserves the original casing.

Diff Mode - new granular_label refining wrong along set relations (exact_match, empty_match, case_only, whitespace, phrase_subset, phrase_superset, phrase_overlap, phrase_disjoint, missed_full, overfired_full), rendered as a badge beside the Jaccard and carried in the exports.

Diff Mode - every row now has a stable row_uid (FNV-1a 32-bit over forwarder, sheet, row and sorted inputs), so the same row shares its id across runs and successive training CSVs can be joined, deduped or diffed. The export dedupes by it.
Diff Mode - CSV column ordering is canonical per forwarder, with cross-forwarder rows clustered dachser, kn, dhl, wackler, so successive exports line up and version-controlled corpora diff cleanly.

Diff Mode - the training export drops padding rows (both cells empty, no rule-visible inputs, no engine output), which used to be emitted as correct rows from below the data range; real correct rows are still kept under the opt-in.
Diff Mode - the detail drawer shows the phrase breakdown directly: missing chips in amber, extra in violet, common in green, the granular badge, the Jaccard and the row_uid, so triage needs no CSV.
Docs - the Diff Mode section of ANMERKUNG-WORKFLOW.md now documents the phrase-diff fields, the granular taxonomy, row_uid semantics, canonical ordering and the padding-row drop.

Wackler - TZ wording switched from "DifferenzEnergiezuschlag" to "DifferenzTreibstof" everywhere, the additive trigger and the pure-TZ fallback, because that is what the training data uses; 16 rows that read wrong now match.

Wackler - rule 1 (Fremdnummer doppelt berechnet) now also fires when the Tarif cell is completely empty and at least one cost-side delta clears the threshold: empty TARIF with real deltas means the comparisons run against a non-existent baseline, and the legacy '-' and zero-with-text signatures still fire as before.

Wackler - rule 1 no longer short-circuits on Kontierung: when Fremdnummer doppelt fires and Kostenstelle and Sachkonto are both blank or X, the row reads "Fremdnummer doppelt berechnet // Kontierung?" instead of the bare phrase, and the casing is normalized to "doppelt".
Rule Tester - added two Wackler presets, "TZ-only Treibstof" for the renamed pure-TZ fallback and "Fremdnummer empty tarif" for the empty-TARIF-with-cost-signal branch.

Dachser - SNK case 75 now splits on the tariff base: SNK_TARIF above 0 classifies as "Differenz Hebebuehnen-Zuschlag", a real tail-lift differential, while an empty or 0 base with SNK_DIFF equal to SNK_DL stays the legacy "Ausfallfracht/Schadensersatz".
Dachser - the default SNK branch routes K1AV rows with a non-standard SNK_DL to "Differenz Laderaumkostenentwicklung"; the non-integer K1AV cases were already handled by the cents-bearing fallback.

Dachser - new early return for the blank-TARIF plus significant-FR pattern: empty Tarif with empty SACH and SERV reads "VORHOLUNG", with both present reads "Fremdnummer Doppelt berechnet", and both short-circuit the Produktzuschlag, Mautdifferenz and Gewichte cascade.

Dachser - only a small negative FR (below 1.0 in magnitude) routes to "Differenz Frachtzu/ abschlag"; a larger negative FR falls through to the weight-deviation wording, which fixes a row read as a surcharge adjustment when it was a weight deviation.

Dachser - the FR weight-tier guard now matches K+N and Wackler: the plural "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte" fires when both volumes are populated and fall into different brackets, the singular when they stay in one bucket or a volume is missing or non-positive.

Diff Mode - the diff CSV export now includes one in_<key> column per rule-visible input cell (volumes, FR/MT/TZ/SNK deltas, tariff, Stat_Freigabe, Sachkonto, Kostenstelle and so on), the union of the filtered scope, so triage needs no side-by-side workbook.
Diff Mode - Dachser rows now capture vkg and vkg_dl in the per-row inputs bag, so they surface in the drawer, the diff CSV and the training exports, at parity with K+N and Wackler.

Dachser - the FR branch gains a weight-tier guard mirroring K+N: volumes crossing a tariff bucket read the plural "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte", while the same bucket or missing volumes keep the legacy singular "Differenz aufgrund von abweichendem Gewicht".
Dachser - resolveDachser now resolves the two volume columns into the cols bag so the guard can read them, and the reason column picks up VKG and VKG_DL for Dachser, matching K+N and Wackler.

Dachser - the weight-tier table is wired directly to the supplied rate card, 44 brackets from 50 kg steps through a single open bucket above 10000 kg; unlike K+N it keeps every 500 kg step in the 8000 to 10000 band and tops out at a real 10000 ceiling.

Wackler - AVIS -8.7 now reads "hätte Avisgebühr telefonisch abrechnen dürfen" instead of the generic "Avis, ok?", since the negative 8.7 is the signature for billing the standard fee where the cheaper telephonic rate applied. Positive +8.7 and the other codes stay sign-insensitive under "Avis, ok?".
Wackler - adds a pure wacklerAvisLabel() helper so the harness can assert the label independently, and the new phrase joins the protected list.

Wackler - the weight tier table is wired directly to the two supplied rate cards, which share breakpoints up to 10000 kg: 50 kg steps to 500, 100 to 2000, 200 to 3000, 500 to 10000, then a single open bucket. The 8000 to 9500 mid-points dropped in 1.8.0 are restored, since they are real international rows.

Wackler - "Wackler rechnet Frachtrate für <tier>kg ab" now reports the exact bucket billed against, so 8743 against 8968 kg both land in "für 9000kg ab" and an auditor can cross-check the tier on the card.
Wackler - adds a tiny pure wacklerTierLabel() helper so the harness verifies tier reporting on its own.
Wackler - engine reworked against a 67-row training set with 9 actionable failure modes resolved, reaching 95.5% accuracy; the 3 residual diffs are cosmetic mislabels in the training data itself.

Wackler - Pauschalfracht detection: when |SNK| is at or above the booked tariff with no FR/MT/TZ delta and no matching surcharge code, the row is a flat-rate freight charge and reads "Pauschalfracht, ok?" instead of the generic "SNK Differenz".

Wackler - the energy surcharge is now an additive trigger rather than a fallback: TZ at or above 2.0 fires alongside FR, MT, weights and bundling, below 2.0 it stays suppressed as fuel-on-(freight+toll) noise, and the pure-TZ wording is "DifferenzEnergiezuschlag".

Wackler - SNK gains a 5 EUR rounding-noise floor: sub-5 EUR gaps on rows that already carry FR/MT/TZ/weights evidence are no longer reported as a separate "SNK Differenz", which was the fuel-on-toll percentage trickling into SNK.

Wackler - the SNK code book is now sign-insensitive with rounding tolerance: |SNK| ≈ 38 reads NL-FIX, ≈ 11.5 "hätte B2C-Line abrechnen dürfen", ≈ 22 "2. Zustellung ok?" and a new ≈ 180 "Terminzustellung, ok?", so a 38.08 NL-FIX is caught.
Wackler - AVIS codes (7.5, 8.5, 6.5, 8.7) are now sign-insensitive, so a credit of -6.5 is the same surcharge as +6.5 and reads "Avis, ok?" instead of being missed.
Wackler - the same-tier wording is now "Wackler rechnet Frachtrate für <tier>kg ab" with the matched bucket, and the old phrase joins the protected list under its prefix.

Wackler - the bundling vs weights cascade is reworked: multi-reference cross-tier weights more than one tier apart read "hätte gebündelt werden müssen", adjacent tiers read "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte", the same tier always wins as "Wackler rechnet", and a single reference falls through to weights.

Wackler - the weight table is tightened in the heavy band: the 8000 to 9500 mid-points are dropped because the upper band is a single 7501 to 10000 bracket, so 8743 against 8968 kg resolve as same-tier instead of a cross-tier discrepancy.

Wackler - NL-FIX zone corollary: when NL-FIX fires, the row carries an FR delta and KOST/SACH are blank, the engine prefixes "Zone korrekt?" and drops the would-be Frachtdifferenz, since the gap is the zone miscode.

Service worker - switched to network-first for all same-origin assets (HTML, JS, CSS, JSON, manifest), so returning users get the latest deployed code on every online load with the cache acting as an offline fallback; cross-origin CDN libraries stay cache-first because they are immutable per URL.

Service worker - fixes the long-standing symptom where rule fixes shipped to source but never reached the live tool because the asset cache kept an older copy of the engine. The old strategy needed a manual VERSION bump per release; the new one needs no cache-bust step for content updates.

Service worker - VERSION bumped v1.4.5 to v1.7.1 once, to rotate the cache name, force a fresh reinstall of the precache list and migrate users off the cache-first flow; future content updates need no bump.

Docs - refreshed README and the two Anmerkung docs for the always-fresh deploy story, the Dachser SNK non-integer surcharge detection and the negative-FR classification, and added the missing FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT setup steps to the Holiday notifier doc.

Dachser - SNK surcharge detection now survives non-integer SNK_DL values: when the cell carries a tariff base with cents (14.72 = 5.71 tariff + 9 surcharge), the engine re-derives the surcharge code from SNK_DIFF and dispatches to the Telephone or Automatic appointment branch instead of the generic "Differenz Laderaumkostenentwicklung".

Dachser - the re-derivation is narrow on purpose: it fires only when SNK_DL is non-integer and SNK_DIFF rounds within 0.05 of a known code (5/9/11/14), so real Laderaumkostenentwicklung rows are untouched; integer cells take the exact-match path.

Dachser - the FR branch gains a Frachtzu/abschlag classification: a negative FR on a single-shipment row with no ZW, Vorholung, K1AS or bundling flag now reads "Differenz Frachtzu/ abschlag" instead of a weight note, since one shipment cannot have a weight miscount.
Dachser - three new Rule Tester presets exercise the fixed branches: "SNK non-int to 9 (Tel. ZTV)", "SNK non-int to 5 (Auto ZTV)" and "Negative FR (Frachtzu/abschlag)".
K+N - new SNK branch: SNK_DL 12 now reads "B2C-zuschlag, ok?", mirroring the Wackler 11.5 classification, where such rows used to fall into the generic "SNK Differenz".

K+N - TZ is now an additive trigger instead of a fallback: a TZ delta coexists with SNK-only classifications such as Portalavisierung, but stays suppressed when FR or MT fired, since the fuel surcharge is a percentage of freight or toll and a gap there is a byproduct.
K+N - the rule tester gains the presets "SNK_DL=12 to B2C-zuschlag" and "Portal + Treibstoff combo".

Diff Mode - "Send to Tester" now pre-fills every numeric field: the diff captures fr_diff, mt_diff, tz_diff, exp_diff, snk_diff, kostenstelle and sachkonto while the tester expects fr, maut, tz, exp, snk, kost and sach, and the old remap covered only six Dachser keys, so everything else silently diverged.

Symptom fix - a K+N Amazon cross-tier row the engine reads as "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte // Portalavisierung, ok?" showed in the tester as "Portalavisierung, ok? // Kontierung?" because FR, kost and sach never arrived; the tester now matches the engine.
The remap is now exhaustive per forwarder (dachser, kn, dhl, wackler) and lives in REMAP_BY_FW beside sendDiffToTester, with a comment on the two key sets and why they drift.
Diff Mode - reworked into a Rule Training console: the A/B slots are labeled Predicted / Expected and the primary action is "Train & Compare".
Training breakdown - click-to-filter chips for wrong, missed, overfired, engine drift and correct, with live counts driving the table and every export.
Filter bar - forwarder, sheet and free-text search across before, after, reason and engine-now, with live "· N" counters on the export buttons.
Per-row expansion - a chevron reveals the exact input cells the engine read and the full trigger trace in a structured grid.
Send to Tester - one click switches the forwarder tile, opens the Rule Tester, fills every matching field, evaluates and scrolls to the result.
Engine-drift column - "Engine now" shows what the current rules would output for slot A's inputs, with a blue dot and the drift chip where the rules changed.
Training set export is filter-scoped, so you can export just the 12 missed Wackler rows or every wrong row; the CSV/JSONL schema is unchanged.
Diff CSV export gains forwarder, label, engine_now, engine_matches_a and the trigger trace alongside the before/after columns.
Single-pass sheet walk - Train & Compare computes label, engine prediction and inputs once per row and reuses them for the table and both exports.

K+N - the Amazon tariff branch now defers to weight-tier evidence: with an Amazon Empf.-Name and a single ReferenzNr the engine checks the volumes first, so a cross-tier pair reads "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte" and only same-tier or missing weights keep "hätte nach Amazon Tarif abrechnen müssen".
K+N - mirrors the Wackler same-tier and cross-tier precedence, so the generic weights vs Amazon decision is consistent across engines.
K+N - new Rule Tester preset "Amazon cross-tier Gewichte" exercises the branch from the UI.
Unchanged: bundling wins over everything, and Pauschalfracht on an empty tariff wins over the Amazon branch.
K+N - new Pauschalfracht rule: an FR difference on a row with no tariff on record reads "Pauschalfracht" instead of the generic weight note, since a flat-rate charge is not a tier miscalculation.
K+N - new SNK rule: SNK_DIFF -9 reads "Differenz avis", the mirror of +9 reading "Avis, ok?", so the sign now decides instead of collapsing to "SNK Differenz".
K+N - |SNK_DIFF| 25 now maps to "Portalavisierung, ok?" like the existing SNK_DL 25 branch, where a 25 diff without the DL tag used to fall through.
K+N - bundling precedence holds: a multi-document ReferenzNr with a different FR still reads "hätte gebündelt werden müssen, ok?" over every other classification, including Pauschalfracht.
K+N - the resolver now reads "Total · Kosten lt. Tarif", and the rule tester gains a Tarif field plus three presets (Pauschalfracht, SNK-diff -9, SNK-diff 25).
Bulk Process - new section for multi-file processing: drop several workbooks and process them all at once with the selected forwarder.
Each processed document gets its own download button.
"Download All as ZIP" bundles every successful result into one timestamped archive.
Per-file status tracking (pending, processing, done or error), a live progress bar and a way to remove files from the queue before running.
Bulk mode respects the "Why?" reason toggle and the advanced thresholds, so it is a first-class citizen of the rule engine.
Wackler - AVIS 8.7 joins the "Avis, ok?" trigger set with 7.5, 8.5 and 6.5.
Wackler - new SNK rule: a diff of 22 reads "2. Zustellung ok?".
Wackler - bundling now suppresses the generic "SNK Differenz": when "hätte gebündelt werden müssen" fires, small residual SNK diffs are treated as part of the bundling gap.
Wackler - the STAT gate is refined: on STAT other than 10 only the Kontierung check runs, so Kontierung can still fire while Avis, Return, SNK, Fracht, Maut and TZ stay silent.

Wackler - smarter weights rule: when the two volumes differ, the tier table decides, same tier reading "Wackler rechnet" as systemic rounding and different tiers reading "Differenz aufgrund abweichender Gewichte", mirroring K+N.
"Wackler rechnet" joins the protected-phrase list so a re-run does not overwrite it.

Diff Mode - new "Training Set" export (CSV and JSONL): for every disagreeing row it writes the predicted and expected values, the label, the input cells the rules read and the trigger trace, ready to feed back into rule work.
The training set auto-detects the forwarder per sheet and falls back to the selected one, so mixed workbooks just work.
"Include matching rows" optionally exports rows where A equals B as positive examples.

Streaming timestamped log with Clear button; aria-live for screen readers.

Offline PWA - install The Alchemist to your machine from Chrome/Edge.

Version badge + "What's new" button in the header.
Preview / dry-run with color-coded per-row status.

Trigger breakdown bar chart + empty/preserved stat tiles.
